title: Kews In Inventory
description: This resource pack changes the inventory texture to a darker, purple theme, and also adds 'shadow art' with a pit biker.
body:
![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24c38d1415050ac21e0c01c3d5d03f04b9b29235_0.webp)

# About the resource pack:

This resource pack changes the textures of some interface elements, making the inventory darker and with Pitbiker in the background, specifically changing the textures of:

- The inventory interface in "survival" and "creative" modes
- The inventory of any creatures that can wear a saddle
- The brewing stand interface
- The interface of all storage blocks (chest, large chest, barrel)
- The shulker interface
- The smithing table interface
- The hopper interface

# Note:

Please do not install this resource pack simultaneously with other similar ones to avoid conflicts.
